title: Contents Packout & Storage Packout, Cleaning and Disposal Billing Rules
content:
## Rules

1. The job must be in authorized, in custody or return scheduled status when a packout, cleaning or disposal line is charged.
2. Packing lines are billed at the tier's unit rate for each box size, wardrobe box, furniture item, crate and electronics item, and an itemized high-value inventory line per high-value item only on tiers that carry that rate; a code whose rate on the tier is 0.00 is not available on that tier.
3. On-site manipulation is billed per room.
4. Truck trips are billed per load and the inventory report once per job.
5. Cleaning lines are billed per item, per box or per cubic foot at the tier's rates.
6. Deodorization is billable only when the loss is fire or smoke, as shown by the loss type of the linked claim file or by a linked fire job, and document freeze-drying only on the commercial tier.
7. Non-salvageable items are never discarded on the company's own decision: they stay inventoried until the owner signs a disposal authorization listing them, and on insurance-funded jobs the inventory with photos is part of the claim before anything is discarded.
8. A disposal haul is charged only after the customer has signed a disposal authorization for the job.
9. Amounts are quantity times unit rate, rounded to the cent, half up.

## Retired clauses

- Rule 1 as a whole, "The job must be in authorized, in custody or return scheduled status when a packout, cleaning or disposal line is charged.", is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current Contents Packout & Storage basis.
- In rule 4, the clause "Truck trips are billed per load" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. The words "and the inventory report once per job" remain in force.
- In rule 9, the clause "Amounts are quantity times unit rate" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. Rounding to the cent, half up, remains in force.

Every other rule above remains in force.

## How the conditions are shown

| Line | Condition | Evidence on the records |
|---|---|---|
| Any packing, cleaning or disposal line | rate on the tier above 0.00 | the tier's price lists |
| Deodorization | the loss is fire or smoke | the loss type of the linked claim file, or a linked fire job (a Fire & Smoke Mitigation job) |
| Document freeze-drying | the job is on the commercial tier, Commercial Contents and Records Recovery | the job's tier |
| Disposal haul | the customer has signed a disposal authorization for this job | a signed disposal authorization recorded for the same job, before the haul is charged |
| Discarding a non-salvageable item | the owner has signed a disposal authorization listing it; on an insurance-funded job the inventory with photos is part of the claim first | the disposal authorization and the job's inventory |

## Which tier rate each line takes

| Line | Rate applied (the tier's figure) |
|---|---|
| small, medium and large box | the tier's small, medium and large box rate |
| wardrobe box | the tier's wardrobe box rate |
| furniture item | the tier's furniture item rate |
| crate | the tier's custom crate rate |
| electronics item | the tier's electronics item rate |
| high-value inventory item | the tier's itemized high-value inventory rate |
| on-site block and pad | the tier's on-site manipulation rate per room |
| contents technician labor | the tier's contents technician hourly rate |
| truck trip | the tier's box truck trip fee |
| inventory report | the tier's inventory report fee |
| disposal haul | the tier's haul-off fee per load |
| soft-goods dry cleaning, ultrasonic cleaning, electronics cleaning | the tier's rate per item for that cleaning |
| hard goods cleaning, deodorization | the tier's rate per box for that cleaning |
| document freeze-drying | the tier's rate per cubic foot |

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

- **Deodorization.** On a job linked to a claim file whose loss type is fire, a deodorization line may be billed; on a job whose claim file shows a water loss and which has no linked fire job, it may not.
- **Unavailable code.** A packing code whose rate on the job's tier is 0.00 is not available on that tier and is not billed at 0.00.
- **Amount rounding.** A hypothetical line amount of 41.235 rounds half up to 41.24.
